reference: clean dataset GT-ground cell median; not independent surveyed DTM
oracle: degraded GT-ground median, not guaranteed best
slope_definition: central differences on reference cell medians, requires finite center and 4 direct neighbors; boundary and unsupported cells unknown
common_scope: intersection of all 14 DALES model outputs, oracle and reference; report own coverage separately
note: Application analysis protocol fixed after segmentation test metrics were known; no model, grid or threshold selection on terrain test results
